title: Harnessing Large Language Models to Compile Task-Relevant Context into Bayesian Optimisation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incorporating rich task-relevant context, such as domain knowledge and external observations, is a key capability yet remains challenging for Bayesian optimisation (BO). Recently, practitioners have started to use large language models (LLMs) to generate and execute BO programs through coding harnesses. In such emerging practices, the posterior belief is shaped not only by Bayesian inference but also by LLM-generated model and data artefacts, offering a flexible route for task context to enter BO as executable code. To study whether and how LLMs can be harnessed to compile diverse contextual signals for BO, we formulate LLM-compiled BO as generalised-context decision making. We propose HarBO, a BO-specialised harness that compiles generalised context into the core artefacts of standard BO through a validated multi-stage workflow. Our theory analyses the regret under imperfect compilation and the effect of adding new context. Across synth

translated_title: 利用大语言模型将任务相关上下文编译到贝叶斯优化中
translated_abstract: 将丰富的任务相关上下文（如领域知识和外部观测）融入贝叶斯优化（BO）是一项关键能力，但至今仍具挑战性。最近，实践者开始使用大语言模型（LLM）通过编程工具链来生成并执行BO程序。在这种新兴实践中，后验信念不仅由贝叶斯推断塑造，还受到LLM生成的模型和数据产物的影响，为任务上下文以可执行代码的形式进入BO提供了灵活途径。为了研究是否以及如何利用LLM为BO编译多样化的上下文信号，我们将LLM编译的BO形式化为广义上下文决策问题。我们提出了HarBO，一个专为BO设计的工具链，通过经过验证的多阶段工作流将广义上下文编译进标准BO的核心产物中。我们的理论分析了不完美编译情况下的遗憾界以及添加新上下文所带来的影响。在合成实验……
tldr: 提出了HarBO——一个专用于贝叶斯优化的LLM工具链，通过经过验证的多阶段工作流将领域知识和外部观测等广义任务上下文编译为标准BO的核心产物，并从理论上分析了不完美编译下的遗憾界及新增上下文的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HarBO, a BO-specialised LLM harness that compiles diverse task-relevant context (such as domain knowledge and external observations) into the core artefacts of standard Bayesian optimisation through a validated multi-stage workflow, with theoretical analysis of regret under imperfect compilation and the effect of adding new context.
